external_entities.name: library member
external_entities.description: A member who uses the library app or a self-service kiosk to borrow, renew, reserve, or return books.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

external_entities.name: desk staff
external_entities.description: Staff who use the circulation page to extend loans, clear account blocks, and mark books as returned.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand
external_entities.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login for the circulation page.

processes.name: library app
processes.description: The app on a member's phone that calls the lending API for borrowing, renewal, and reservation actions.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: lending API
processes.description: The REST service that accepts loan and reservation actions and reads or writes the loans database.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: Authentication is unverified: Priya said, "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look." Exposure is disputed. Lending service note: "The lending API is internal-only." Interview transcript: "The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet."

processes.name: self-service kiosk
processes.description: A branch kiosk where a member scans their library card and books being borrowed or returned.
processes.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.
processes.notes: The kiosk's direct interaction with the loans database is unknown: Priya said, "I couldn't tell you what they talk to these days. I only ever see what arrives at the API."

data_stores.name: loans database
data_stores.description: The single database containing members, loans, reservations, names, email addresses, home addresses, and full borrowing histories.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.
data_stores.notes: The earlier statement about two databases was corrected: "We merged those in the spring. It's one loans database now. The old reservations database is gone."

data_flows.name: borrow or renew
data_flows.description: A member uses the library app to request borrowing, renewal, or reservation actions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.
data_flows.data_description: Borrowing, renewal, and reservation requests identifying the member and book or title.

data_flows.name: change loan
data_flows.description: The library app calls the lending API with a member and book or title, and the API processes the requested change.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member, and the API checks the loan rules and writes the change.
data_flows.notes: The API's authentication behavior is unknown. Priya said, "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look."
data_flows.data_description: Member, book, borrowing, renewal, or reservation request.

data_flows.name: scan books
data_flows.description: A member scans a library card and books at a self-service kiosk.
data_flows.source_excerpt: a member scans their library card and the books they are borrowing or returning
data_flows.data_description: Library card and books being borrowed or returned.

data_flows.name: send loan
data_flows.description: The kiosk sends each loan and return to the lending API as it is scanned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks send each loan and each return to the lending API.
data_flows.data_description: Loan and return records, including the member and books scanned.

data_flows.name: change loan
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page served by the lending API to extend loans, clear account blocks, or mark books returned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: The circulation page uses one shared desk account. The password is on a card taped under the desk, and the page does not ask again.
data_flows.data_description: Manual loan changes, account-block changes, and return records.

data_flows.name: read or write loans
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Members, loans, reservations, contact details, and borrowing histories.

trust_boundaries.name: branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network used by branch kiosks and desk staff.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data centre where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

trust_boundaries.name: member phone
trust_boundaries.description: The device on which a member uses the library app.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

assumptions.assumption: The contents of the loans database are confidential because it contains names, email addresses, home addresses, and full borrowing histories.
assumptions.basis: The Interview transcript states: "Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database."
